description: This file declares utility functions, structures, and includes for certificate verification, reading, writing, and processing DER and PEM certificates within the Chromium project.

classes.name: CertInput
classes.description: Stores DER certificate bytes and source information for logging and processing.

classes.name: CertInputWithTrustSetting
classes.description: Associates a CertInput with a trust setting for certificate validation.

methods.name: ReadCertificatesFromFile
methods.description: Parses a file as a DER or PEM certificate list, outputting certificates.

methods.name: ReadChainFromFile
methods.description: Parses a file as a DER or PEM chain, separating target and intermediates.

methods.name: ReadFromFile
methods.description: Reads file content into a string, with error reporting.

methods.name: WriteToFile
methods.description: Writes data to a file, with error reporting.

methods.name: PrintCertError
methods.description: Outputs an error message related to a specific certificate.

methods.name: PrintDebugData
methods.description: Outputs debug information from user data.

methods.name: FingerPrintCryptoBuffer
methods.description: Generates a SHA256 fingerprint of a certificate buffer.

methods.name: SubjectFromX509Certificate
methods.description: Extracts a textual subject from an X509Certificate.

methods.name: SubjectFromCryptoBuffer
methods.description: Extracts a textual subject from a crypto buffer.
